summary: Stop accepting new connections while preserving asynchronous close completion.

target.notes: Returns the same Server and completes only according to Node connection lifecycle; not equivalent to immediate socket disposal.

semantics.notes: Returns the same Server and completes only according to Node connection lifecycle; not equivalent to immediate socket disposal.

caveats: Preserve Node stream/EventEmitter, host ordering, header state, and network/TLS behavior rather than substituting unrelated .NET HTTP defaults.
